newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX turn higher as products rise.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX turn higher as products rise.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices in Asia were firmer in late afternoon dealings on Wednesday amid indications of stronger global product prices.
Singapore gas oil swaps made a technical rebound after a recent price plunge and gas oil futures in London were $3.00 per tonne firmer.
Traders said a fire at Tosco Avon refinery in California was helping sentiment but a trader said he doubted it would have a more direct affect on prices.
March Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $22.53 per barrel, up 17 cents from London and reversing earlier four cent losses.
March NYMEX, trading on ACCESS was last traded at $24.35, up 13 cents from New York, while February heating oil was up 0.22 cents at 66.25 cents compared with New York.

Gas oil has dropped around 20 percent in Singapore over the last two weeks, but the slide appeared to come to a halt on Wednesday when February swaps were indicated at $25.50/$25.70 from a day-earlier $25.10/$25.30.
